name: The Cooking Club
detailed_description:
The Cooking Club is a Slice-Of-Life // Dating Sim visual novel that is produced in the Ren'Py engine!

Ready to start cooking?

High school can be a drag—especially when you’re stuck in classes you can’t stand. Looking for an easy escape, our protagonist.. YOU! (Yes - You!) stumbles upon the only club with an open spot: The Cooking Club.

What starts as a simple excuse to ditch class quickly turns into something far more delicious. Between chopping, stirring, and whisking up new dishes, unexpected sparks begin to fly. Will you master the recipe for love, or will things boil over? With a cast of charming clubmates, secret ingredients of romance, and just a pinch of chaos, The Cooking Club is serving up a story that’s equal parts heart-warming and hilarious. So grab your apron—because in this kitchen, love is always on the menu!

But remember.. each decision you make comes with a choice and a path - you can't have every girl to yourself!

Choice-Driven Narrative – Every decision stirs the pot! Your interactions with club members influence their opinions, relationships, and even how the story unfolds. Choose wisely, because in this kitchen, romance is a delicate recipe!

Cooking Mini-Games – Get hands-on with cooking challenges! Chop, stir, and plate up delicious dishes in interactive mini-games that test your timing and precision.

Multiple Love Interests – From the fiery Akemi to the reserved Isabella, each club member has their own unique personality and storyline. Build bonds, spark romance, and see where your journey takes you!

Branching Paths & Endings – Will your high school days be filled with laughter, love, or a dash of chaos? Your choices lead to multiple endings, making every playthrough a fresh experience.

Vibrant Visuals & Voice Acting – Enjoy expressive character sprites, detailed CGs, and immersive voice acting that bring The Cooking Club to life!

Kickstarter-Exclusive Content – Back us on Kickstarter to unlock extra features, including additional CG scenes, sneak peaks on any upcoming DLC and more!

Sweet, reliable, and always there to lend a helping hand, Daisy has been by your side for as long as you can remember. She may not be the best cook, but she makes up for it with enthusiasm (and a few questionable culinary experiments). Could there be more than just friendship simmering between you two?

"Come on, you really think I’d let you join the club without me? We’re a team, remember?"

A master in the kitchen but cold as ice, Isabella keeps her heart locked up tighter than a pressure cooker. She prefers working alone and doesn’t take kindly to distractions—especially you. But if you’re patient enough, you might just be the one to melt her frozen exterior and taste the warmth beneath.

“It’s… been a while since someone actually wanted to get to know me. I don’t hate it.”

The heart and soul of The Cooking Club, Evelyn is as bold as the flavours she creates. Always energetic and ready to push you out of your comfort zone, she believes that cooking (and love) should be done with passion. Can you keep up with her fiery pace, or will you get burned?

                         “You’ve got talent. Stop doubting yourself and just go for it!”

Small but mighty, Akemi’s temper is as explosive as an overheated pot. She’s quick to snap but even quicker to blush when flustered. Beneath her sharp tongue lies a heart that’s waiting for someone who can handle the heat. Are you up for the challenge

           “I-It’s not like I made this just for you or anything! D-Don’t get the wrong idea!”

So - are you ready to join The Cooking Club?

content_descriptors.notes:
The Cooking Club features brief occasions of sexual content (characters in compromising situations & revealing outfits) and mature topics (such as depression, anxiety, alcohol abuse and suicidal themes being brought to light)

The Cooking Club in no way endorses any of the topics conveyed and the game does NOT contain any 'H-Scenes'.
